layer_vocabulary.notes: The oracle decides the rules layer only. Approval-policy outcomes and sandbox confinement are separate layers: measured only by designed runtime probes under pinned approval_policy + sandbox_mode (not yet run in week 1). Observed effect is out of week-1 scope. Unknowns carry mandatory layer attribution: 'no rules-layer decision; outcome depends on approval policy + sandbox under the pinned configuration' (INV-004, Option A).
